### 界面尺寸与主界面精简 / Compact UI and a simpler welcome view

- **界面收紧一档**：保留雾蓝配色和完整菜单，将消息正文从 16px 调整为 15px，顶部栏从 96px 调整为 84px；同步缩小导航按钮、会话行高、头像、输入工具、文件卡和设置尺寸，不改变用户的缩放偏好。
- **主界面仅保留随机文案**：移除中央 logo、“茶话间”标题和额外引导文字，仅显示随机文案与署名。
- **隐藏会话后不再显示提示**：移除“聊天内容已隐藏，点击会话可重新打开”；隐藏与重新打开会话的操作保持不变。
- **More compact UI**: keep the blue palette and all menus while reducing message text from 16px to 15px and headers from 96px to 84px. Navigation buttons, conversation rows, avatars, composer tools, file cards and settings are also smaller. User zoom preferences remain unchanged.
- **Quotation-only welcome view**: remove the central logo, Teahouse heading and extra instructions, leaving only a random quotation and its author.
- **No hidden-conversation notice**: remove the extra notice after hiding a chat; hiding and reopening conversations work as before.

### 验证 / Validation

- Linux 本地通过 138 个测试文件 / 1014 项测试、Electron ABI 数据库自测、类型检查、构建与渲染体积检查、Xvfb 启动冒烟；版本与双语文档检查通过。
- 实际 Electron 22 / Chromium 108 检查覆盖浅深主题、初始与隐藏会话状态、私聊 8 个和群聊 7 个输入入口、通讯录、文件柜、七组设置、最小窗口与真实 125% 缩放；中英文输入及发送快捷键正常，渲染器错误为 0。
- 截图和交互检查使用隔离演示数据；本轮未进行跨机器聊天或文件实发，也未在 Windows 7、macOS 真机复测字体和原生窗口边缘。
- Local Linux checks passed 1014 tests in 138 files, Electron ABI database checks, typechecks, build/bundle budgets, Xvfb smoke, and version/documentation consistency checks.
- Actual Electron 22 / Chromium 108 checks covered both themes, initial and hidden-chat states, all composer tools, contacts, cabinets, seven settings sections, minimum windows and real 125% zoom. Chinese/English input and send shortcuts worked with no renderer errors.
- UI checks used isolated fixtures. This round did not repeat cross-machine message/file transfers or physical Windows 7/macOS font and window-edge checks.
